title: When LLMs Benchmark Themselves: Deconstructing Self-Bias in Automated Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2509.26600v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As LLMs rapidly saturate existing benchmarks, automated benchmark creation using LLMs (LLM as a benchmark) where a model generates test inputs (LLM as a testset) and evaluates outputs (LLM as an evaluator) has gained traction as a cheap alternative to human curation. We show that this paradigm has a fundamental problem: LLM-generated benchmarks systematically favor the model that created them. Using machine translation as our primary testbed, we find that self bias arises from two compounding sources, LLM as a testset and LLM as an evaluator, and their combination amplifies the effect. Crucially, even when test data is generated with explicit diversity controls, each model\'s implicit stylistic tendencies produce homogeneous, model-specific outputs that inflate its own scores. translated_title: 当大语言模型为自己做基准测试：解构自动化评估中的自我偏好
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）迅速填满现有基准测试，使用LLM自动创建基准（LLM作为基准）——即由模型生成测试输入（LLM作为测试集）并评估输出（LLM作为评估器）——作为一种廉价的人工策划替代方案正日益受到关注。我们证明这一范式存在一个根本性问题：LLM生成的基准测试会系统性地偏向创建它的模型。以机器翻译作为主要测试平台，我们发现自我偏好源于两个相互叠加的因素：LLM作为测试集和LLM作为评估器，二者的结合会进一步放大这种效应。至关重要的是，即使测试数据在生成时采用了显式的多样性控制，每个模型隐式的风格倾向仍会产生同质化的、模型特有的输出，从而抬高其自身的得分。使用我们提出的多样性指标来增加源文本的多样性，可以部分缓解这种偏差。这种自我偏好足以使每个模型……
tldr: LLM自动生成的基准测试会系统性地偏向创建它的模型本身，这种“自我偏好”源于“LLM作为测试集”和“LLM作为评估器”两个环节的叠加效应，即使引入多样性控制也只能部分缓解。
en_tdlr: LLM-generated benchmarks systematically favor the model that created them, a self-bias arising from the compounding effects of LLM-as-a-testset and LLM-as-an-evaluator, which can only be partially mitigated by increasing source text diversity.
